full_judgment: 4. The pre-emptor-petitioner deposed himself as PW 1 and produced another witness PW No. 2 in support of his case. The pre-emptor had also produced certain documents which were not at all legible, though marked as Exhibit 1 series and 2. The pre-emptee (defendant) has examined (two) witnesses namely, OPW Nos. 1 and 2 and had also proved the DCR dated 19-2-1984 Exhibit "Ka", CS Khatian No. 402 of Mouza Dharoki, marked as Exhibit "Kha", and also the deed No. 4932 dated 21-4-1982 Exhibit "Ga".
